local_setup_divergence.notes: The copied bic:diagnose skill matched the pinned Factory manifest. The Cloud checkout lacked its local-only factory context file, so this run created an ignored local context record pointing at the already-confirmed Factory commit. Local dependency installation was unavailable because the sandbox could not reach PyPI; the focused stdlib-only harness suite ran locally, while FastAPI-backed conformance and the full real-process journey are delegated to GitHub Actions.

roadmap_reconciliation.notes: Factory onboarding roadmap #90 remains validating. Cloud #137 is the terminal Hosted Product Create + Join acceptance lane. Its human owner clarified the single-domain alpha boundary on 2026-07-17: the terminal browser journey has only the creator and same-domain peer; cross-domain admission, ticket, and daemon denial remain blocking conformance/security evidence.

state_refinement.release_state: No lifecycle behavior changed. The validation harness follows the already-shipped daemon-owned pending pairing lifecycle, exercises the two-actor single-domain Hosted Product Create + Join journey, and retains the complete redacted evidence needed for human review.
invariants: Canonical Product state, pairing authority, and persistence semantics did not change.
Only the local daemon confirmation surface may approve a pending hosted-bridge request; Cloud and the hosted origin cannot mint a session.
A protocol-incompatible pairing client fails closed instead of falling back to immediate-token behavior.
Alpha admits only bicameral-ai.com; the terminal journey must not add a second admitted domain or third terminal identity solely to manufacture a browser eligibility case.
Cross-domain Cloud admission, Product ticket, and daemon membership denial remain blocking conformance/security evidence.

minimization_review.rationale: This is an executable-topology and evidence-integrity repair only. Introducing a second admitted domain, third terminal actor, or new durable/display state would exceed the owner-approved single-domain alpha boundary.

state_refinement.notes: The harness locally simulates the operator's explicit approval solely to construct the disposable test topology; it does not alter production authority or persistence. Playwright traces are written first to the disposable root, scrubbed of known ephemeral credentials, and only then copied into retained evidence.

end_of_session_capture.notes: Factory learning signals: the terminal topology carried a second handwritten hosted-pairing client that drifted from protocol-v3 pending confirmation, and its receipt collapsed machine-complete evidence with human product acceptance. The new regression tests lock the production handshake, two-actor alpha scope, redacted evidence retention, and pending-human-review classification; a future shared client/contract-generated harness would reduce recurrence.
